text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager triggered: spike of GPU OOMs on pool 'prefill-gpu-pool' (hosts gpunode-17,gpunode-18). Containers restarting. Error rate 12% over last 3m. Paging @ryan (oncall). Logs: /var/log/prefill/error.log (attached).
ryan (oncall): ack — jumping in. any customer impact yet? which models/pool? :eyes:
jenna (eng-runtime): seeing large context prefill errors on rtx-a6000 nodes, mostly requests with >200k tokens (attachments long chat dumps). Error snippet from pod gprefill-7:
```
2026-03-17T02:15:12Z ERROR runtime: cudaMalloc failed: out of memory
prefill_worker.cpp:312 handle_prefill() {CUDA_ERROR_OUT_OF_MEMORY}
container: restart count=3
```
matt (sre): node gpunode-17 shows rapid mem pressure and kubelet restarting container runtime. dmesg has NVRM: GPU reset detected. Might be kernel driver reset after OOM.
ryan (oncall): ok — immediate plan: 1) cordon gpunode-17, 2) move traffic off prefill pool -> route to fallback coldmodel, 3) enable aggressive prefill trimming config for problematic requests. jemma? (typo) jenna: on it. executing cordon + drain (evicting pods gracefully).
jenna (eng-runtime): running:
```
kubectl cordon gpunode-17
kubectl drain gpunode-17 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --force --grace-period=30
```
jenna (eng-runtime): starting config tweak: deploy 2x instances of fallback small-quantized model and flip routing rule for prefill path to prefer fallback on failures. applying rollout.
ops-bot: route-change: prefilling traffic redirected to fallback-coldmodel v2 for pool prefills. (change-id: rc-2026-0317-01)
emma (cust-success): FYI we've received 1 support ticket from AcmeCorp complaining about "service failing mid-upload". I'll notify affected customers and open a ticket linking to this thread. any ETA for mitigation?
ryan (oncall): expected mitigation -> 10-12m after drain completes and routing flips. matt — monitor node flapping, if it keeps resetting we may need to remove driver module or reboot host.
matt (sre): kernel shows repeated GPU resets, but other nodes stable. I will reprovision gpunode-17 after coldmove. I recommend blacklisting gpunode-17 until we validate driver/firmware. creating ticket: SRE-2026-045.
jenna (eng-runtime): also enabling prefill-size cap: max_prefill_tokens=65536 for now and enabling prefix cache trimming for long keys. This will deny extremely long prefill requests with 413 until client reduces size — we'll return structured error to gateway so SDKs can surface it.
ryan (oncall): good. add temporary rate-limit of 4 req/s per API key for prefill route to avoid thundering herd.
ops-bot: config-update: max_prefill_tokens=65536, prefill_rate_limit=4/s (applied to prefills). (change-id: cfg-2026-0317-02)
emma (cust-success): AcmeCorp informed: we suggested retry with shorter history and offered a dedicated support call. They've paused heavy imports for now.
jenna (eng-runtime): quick patch pushed to runtime: catch cuda OOM during prefill and fallback to CPU-coldmodel on a per-request basis (non-blocking). Patch id: PR#4821. Rolling canary to 10% first.
ryan (oncall): monitoring metrics — errors reduced from 12% -> 2% after routing to fallback and caps. will keep gpunode-17 cordoned.
matt (sre): creating postmortem stub and scheduling follow-up to check driver firmware and NVidia packages on node. If we see recurring resets across nodes, escalate to infra.
jenna (eng-runtime): follow-up tasks: 1) expose prefill token count in request logs for debugging, 2) add server-side prefill rejection with helpful error + docs link, 3) evaluate incremental KV-cache trimming heuristics.
ryan (oncall): oncall clear in 45m if no more regrowth. tagging for handoff to next oncall @sre-oncall tomorrow 07:00 UTC. thanks all :thumbsup:
ops-bot: incident-note: mitigation steps taken: cordon gpunode-17, redirect prefills to fallback-coldmodel, apply prefill caps and rate limits, deployed runtime OOM catch fallback (PR#4821). Incident severity set to Sev2. Incident owner: ryan (oncall).
